'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches a massive [[missile]] and [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]] attack across [[Ukraine]], killing at least four people and injuring 38 others in [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast|Dnipropetrovsk]], [[Kharkiv Oblast|Kharkiv]], [[Khmelnytskyi Oblast|Khmelnytskyi]] and [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Zaporizhzhia]] Oblasts. Ukraine says that it shot down all eight drones and 18 of 51 missiles. [https://apnews.com/article/ukraine-russia-missiles-kharkiv-1a36d45089e6014e07af69ca9f88b63f (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-launches-missile-attacks-across-country-say-ukrainian-officials-2024-01-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Wissam al-Tawil]], the deputy commander of [[Hezbollah]]'s [[Redwan Force]], and a militant is assassinated in an [[Israel|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] in [[Majdel Selm]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-lebanon-kills-senior-commander-elite-hezbollah-unit-security-2024-01-08/ (Reuters)]
**Hezbollah launches a drone attack on Israel's [[Northern Command (Israel)|Northern Command]] headquarters in [[Safed]] marking its deepest incursion into Israeli territory since the outbreak of hostilities.[https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20240109-hezbollah-launches-drone-attack-on-israel-in-response-to-top-commanders-killing/ (Middle East Monitor)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***The [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North|SPLM-N (al-Hilu)]] together with the [[Sudanese Armed Forces|SAF]] clashed with the [[Rapid Support Forces|RSF]] in the [[Nuba Mountains]], while the SAF launched airstrikes on an RSF camp in Al-Dabaibat, north of [[Dalang, South Kordofan|Dalang]], [[South Kordofan]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article281115/ (Sudan Tribune)]

*[[Agriculture in Germany|Farmers]] block highway access roads in parts of [[Germany]], launching a week of protests against a government plan to remove tax breaks on diesel used in agriculture. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-67911739 (BBC News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**According to ''[[De Volkskrant]]'', a Dutch engineer recruited by the [[General Intelligence and Security Service]] of [[the Netherlands]] released the [[Malware|malicious]] [[computer worm]] [[Stuxnet]] in an [[Iran]]ian nuclear complex in 2007, disrupting the Iranian nuclear program for years. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2504114-nederlander-saboteerde-atoomcomplex-in-iran-den-haag-wist-niets (NOS)] [https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/dutch-spies-hid-engineers-role-in-stalling-iran-nuclear-project-dtqh3s2hq (''The Times'')]
*[[Peregrine Mission One]], the first [[United States|US]] lunar lander since the [[Apollo program]], is launched at [[Cape Canaveral Space Force Station|Cape Canaveral]] in [[Florida]], [[United States]]. It later suffers from a fuel leak, making it unable to complete its objective. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2024/jan/08/nasa-peregrine-1-vulcan-rocket-carrying-nasa-moon-lander-lifts-off-in-florida (''The Guardian'')]
